name: v6_backup_corrupt_or_unknown_schema_refused
boundary: restore of a corrupted backup and of an unknown-schema manifest
seed_method: packaged hooks seed a store; daemon stopped; a valid backup is taken; then one tree file is tampered and, separately, the manifest schema is bumped beyond this build; each restore is aimed at its own fresh destination
reason: restore refuses a corrupted backup and an unknown-schema manifest, and in neither case does it publish a destination .qompack; the failures are reported, not swept.
detail: corrupt_refusal="store: restore backup \"good\": .gitignore: store: backup does not match its manifest: longer than its manifest size; the incomplete staging tree is preserved as evidence at /tmp/qompack-fault-2035955565/dest-corrupt/.qompack.restore-good-7a17e62b1160bb42"; schema_refusal="store: backup manifest is unusable: backup \"good\" manifest version 999 is not readable by this build"
